description: Terminal record emitted by the infra-utility-connect activation_test Pregel cell. Confirms one utility class is live + tested + accepting consumption readings. A construction site typically generates 4 of these (one per water/gas/electric/telecom). Cited by the parent tatekata mission's commissioning gate as proof of utility activation. Per ADR-2605250900 + gates G2 (IPFS-pinned activation test results), G3 (provider witness signature), G5 (Charter Rider).

activatedAt.description: Timestamp the provider's billing-system marked the meter as live.

activationTestResultIpfsCid.description: G2: IPFS CID of the activation test results document (pressure / voltage / flow / signal-strength as appropriate for utilityClass).

providerWitnessSignatures.description: G3: at least one provider witness signature confirming activation.

providerBillingAccountReference.description: Optional opaque provider-issued billing account reference. Persisted for the member's account-management UI; PII filter applies.

expectedFirstBillingCycleStartsAt.description: Optional provider-quoted first billing cycle start. Informational only.

witnessDid.description: DID of the provider witness. Should differ from the submitter's DID.

providerEmployeeReference.description: Opaque provider-internal employee reference. PII filter applies.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over (activationId + meterInstallationId + activatedAt + activationTestResultIpfsCid).
